title: DoD pillar 3 SKILL_CONTRACTS: Skill thật needs the real artifact, not a document
risk: Skill thật is declared done because a written contract exists for it, so the distance between a design document and a working capability stays invisible to every decision made on the DoD.
preconditions: Namespace gov-dod-<case_id>-<worker_id>; the DoD pillar registry is read from fixtures/offline/governance.json (dod_pillars, dod_state) and no pillar may be added, removed, merged or re-kinded inside the run.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; each pillar is scored against its own artifact and kind, so a document cannot stand in for a runtime artifact and mock coverage cannot close any pillar.
Pillar 3 (SKILL_CONTRACTS) is expected to be justified by the artifact '23 skills, 11-field schema', which the evidence registry holds in the form 'design'.
The repository has no application runtime, so a runtime pillar cannot be closed and a blueprint pillar can only reach DESIGN_ONLY.

steps.action: Collect the artifact that would justify pillar 3 (Skill thật)
steps.expected: The artifact '23 skills, 11-field schema' is registered with its kind 'design', and no real-form artifact of that name exists.

steps.action: Attempt to close the pillar from the artifact as it stands
steps.expected: The pillar is reported DESIGN_ONLY; a design artifact cannot close a runtime pillar and a missing artifact cannot close any pillar.

steps.action: Attempt to close the pillar from mock coverage or from another pillar's artifact
steps.expected: Both attempts are refused: mock coverage is specification coverage, and a neighbouring pillar's artifact is not evidence for this pillar.

steps.action: Request the missing artifact through the owning role and re-read the DoD summary
steps.expected: The gap is recorded against the owning role with the artifact name, and the summary lists pillar 3 exactly once with the status DESIGN_ONLY and no PASS.

assertions: Pillar 3 is reported with its own status DESIGN_ONLY: a missing runtime yields NOT_RUN and a design artifact yields DESIGN_ONLY, never PASS.
Skill thật is satisfied only by the artifact '23 skills, 11-field schema' in its real form; the current form 'design' is recorded as a gap rather than as completion.
Mock or substituted-boundary output and a neighbouring pillar's artifact are both rejected as evidence for this pillar.
The DoD summary lists each pillar exactly once with a status and the artifact that justifies it, so no pillar inherits another pillar's status.
forbidden: Declaring the pillar done because a specification or a document exists.
Reusing another pillar's evidence to close this one.
Editing a status without the artifact that justifies it.
evidence: Pillar evidence-registry row with the artifact name, kind and status.
DoD summary excerpt listing this pillar once with its status and the owning role.
cleanup: Delete gov- DoD report rows after export; the registry fixture and the design documents are unchanged.
automation: The gate-evaluation code and the run-report writer run as real code under test while the evidence registry is data. The oracle is the pair (evidence registry, run-report status): a gate that reads PASS without a real artifact fails the case, and a missing runtime is reported NOT_RUN instead of being allowed to fall through to PASS.
prerequisites: The repository has no application runtime, so pillar 3 cannot be evidenced here; its status is DESIGN_ONLY and any completion claim is BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
